summary: In Room 1313, Agent Smith stands over Mouse's dead body. He then moves his hand to his earpiece, apparently to communicate.

what_changes.before: Standing over Mouse's dead body, apparently still assessing the kill.
what_changes.after: Shifts to communication mode, hand going to his earpiece to report or coordinate.
what_changes.evidence: Agent Smith stands over Mouse's dead body, his hand going to his earpiece.

event_hint.one_line: Agent Smith, having killed Mouse, signals his people via earpiece.
